experience.title: Software Engineer I
experience.description: Frontend engineer building and scaling high-traffic consumer-facing web applications for logistics and rides platforms serving millions of daily users.
experience.detailed_desc_html:
• ▸Architected 12+ production dashboards using React — spanning 70+ pages with reusable, configuration-driven UI components, reducing feature development time by ~30%
  • ▸Optimized state management and resolved critical UI bottlenecks — achieving ~40% improvement in responsiveness for high-volume user bases across real-time dashboards
  • ▸Shipped surge pricing, zonal promotions, and lifecycle management tools powering logistics and rides operations supporting millions of daily transactions
  • ▸Designed multi-language support (Bengali, English, Nepali) — expanding platform accessibility across 3 regions
  • ▸Containerized services with Docker and strengthened CI/CD pipelines — enabling reliable production rollouts and reduced deployment friction
